title: Cooler board, rating changer and a brand-new home screen
notes: 🎨 Board styles: pick from 8 looks — Classic wood, Tournament green, Ocean, Midnight, Marble, Candy, Sunset and glowing Neon. Tap "Board style" under any board.
The board got a 3D frame, bigger pieces with shadows, and moves now slide smoothly across the board.
✏️ Change my rating: set your rating for bot and friend games — pick a level or type an exact number.
A brand-new home screen with a live board replaying famous games like Morphy's Opera Game.
